clue.text: Policemen carrying Indian princess up to the tower

indicators.note: the police hold the next piece inside them, as if carrying it along
in a down clue, going up means the word is read from bottom to top

blocks.note: the Met is London's Metropolitan Police
a rani is an Indian princess or queen

explanation.surface: Officers escort an Indian royal up to a tower, like a scene from a period drama.
explanation.walkthrough: The reversed princess sits inside MET to give MINARET.
explanation.definitionFit: A minaret is the slender tower of a mosque from which the call to prayer is given.

clue.text: Good heavens! Mrs Smith and Miss Lear!

blocks.note: a British exclamation of surprise
Delia Smith is a famous British television cook

explanation.surface: An exclamation of surprise at meeting two ladies, a married Mrs Smith and an unmarried Miss Lear.
explanation.walkthrough: Cor is a British expression of astonishment; Delia Smith is Britain's best-known TV cookery writer.
explanation.definitionFit: Cordelia is King Lear's youngest daughter in Shakespeare's play, an unmarried woman of that family.

clue.text: Obsessive graduate turned murderer

indicators.note: turned round means the name of the killer is read in the opposite direction

blocks.note: Master of Arts, a graduate degree
Cain killed his brother Abel in Genesis

explanation.surface: A fixated university graduate who became a killer, like a crime-thriller premise.
explanation.walkthrough: MA followed by the reversed CAIN (NIAC) gives MANIAC.
explanation.definitionFit: A maniac is someone with an obsessive, extreme enthusiasm or compulsion, an obsessive person.

clue.text: Upkeep's a personal problem; love is child's play

indicators.note: in a down clue the attached word is read upwards, from bottom to top

blocks.note: the word after the signal Up, turned upwards
taken as written
BO is body odour, a classic personal problem
love is zero in tennis, which looks like O

explanation.surface: Maintenance costs are a private worry, while romance is easy by comparison.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upkeep' looks like one word for maintenance, but it splits into the reversal signal Up and keep.
explanation.definitionFit: Peekaboo is a game played with babies and toddlers, literally a child's game of hiding and revealing the face.

clue.text: Censor type of headline

blocks.note: first meaning, read cryptically: one who bans things
second meaning: a headline running across the full width of a newspaper page

explanation.surface: A newspaper censor and a style of headline, both from the world of the press.
explanation.walkthrough: Censor is defined whimsically: someone who bans is a ban-ner.
explanation.definitionFit: A banner headline spans a whole front page; a censor, punningly, is a person who bans material.

clue.text: Emergency connection with erotic verse?

blocks.note: hot can mean sexy or steamy
a line is a single row of verse

explanation.surface: A dirty poem passed down an urgent telephone link, as though a sex chatline were an emergency service.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the playful reading of the answer as a steamy piece of poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: A hotline is a direct telephone link kept open for urgent use, such as between heads of state in a crisis.

clue.text: Loaf baked in tricky situation by personal organiser

indicators.note: baking transforms dough, so the bread word comes out in a new form
one piece is placed inside the other

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged
being in a fix is being in a predicament

explanation.surface: A loaf of bread cooked in an awkward situation next to someone's diary.
explanation.walkthrough: Fix here is a predicament, not a repair; the bread is the anagram fodder, not part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Filofax is the trade name of a ring-bound personal organiser, an iconic 1980s diary and address book.

clue.text: Senior politician committing treason

indicators.note: the crime is committed, i.e. acted out, so its letters are put into play in a new arrangement

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A high-ranking politician guilty of betraying their country.
explanation.definitionFit: A senator sits in a senate, the upper and often more senior chamber of a legislature.

clue.text: Western Greek was so upset at the treatment centre

indicators.note: things that are upset are knocked over and end up in disorder

blocks.note: W is the abbreviation for western
taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A man from western Greece is distressed by his care at a clinic.
explanation.walkthrough: The W joins the other letters before they are shuffled together.
explanation.definitionFit: A sewage works is a plant where waste water is processed, a place of wastewater treatment.

clue.text: Statesman also slicing butter

indicators.note: a blade slicing into something goes inside it

blocks.note: and means also, in addition
ghi, or ghee, is clarified butter used in Indian cooking

explanation.surface: A statesman who also cuts butter, a homely kitchen image.
explanation.walkthrough: GHI is a variant spelling of ghee, apt for the Indian leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Mahatma Gandhi led India's independence movement and is revered as a great political leader.

clue.text: Need link to supply light

indicators.note: read as supple-y, in a flexible way, so the letters bend into a new order

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A connection is required to provide electric lighting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Supply' looks like provide, but is read as an adverb from supple, meaning flexibly.
explanation.definitionFit: To enkindle is to set on fire or ignite, so it means to light as a verb.

clue.text: Healthy in Spring

blocks.note: first meaning: in good health
second meaning: a source of water

explanation.surface: Feeling fit in the springtime.
explanation.walkthrough: Spring looks like the season, but here it is a water source.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling well means healthy; a well is also a spring of water, or water springs up from the ground.

clue.text: Feature concealing light on good old-fashioned fornication

indicators.note: a thing concealing something holds it hidden inside

blocks.note: the chin is a facial feature
the amber light of a traffic signal
G is the abbreviation for good

explanation.surface: A facial feature hiding a light, set beside a quaint word for illicit sex.
explanation.walkthrough: On places G after the container. Chambering is an archaic word from the King James Bible (Romans 13:13).
explanation.definitionFit: Chambering is an obsolete term for wanton sexual behaviour, literally activity conducted in bedchambers.

clue.text: Corrected bias, giving fresh sign to rape victims

indicators.note: a correction rearranges what was wrong into a new form

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged
fresh means new
an omen is a sign of what is to come

explanation.surface: Removing prejudice offers new hope to victims of a crime.
explanation.walkthrough: The Rape of the Sabine Women is the Roman legend of the mass abduction of Sabine women, a common subject in art.
explanation.definitionFit: In Roman legend, Romulus's men abducted the Sabine women, an episode known traditionally as their rape.

clue.text: Partial to popular brand in compact disc

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

blocks.note: in means fashionable or popular
a line is a brand or range of products
CD is the abbreviation for compact disc

explanation.surface: Fond of a well-known label packaged on a CD.
explanation.definitionFit: Being inclined to something means having a liking or leaning towards it, being partial to it.

clue.text: Soldier, perhaps English one, originally called Rex

blocks.note: Eng is the abbreviation for English
I is the Roman numeral one
née means born as, used before a maiden name
R is the abbreviation for Rex, king

explanation.surface: A soldier, perhaps English, once went by the name Rex.
explanation.walkthrough: Née, French for born, introduces the name a person was originally called; Rex here is just the abbreviation R.
explanation.definitionFit: An engineer is a soldier in the army's engineering corps, such as the Royal Engineers, hence perhaps.

clue.text: Surround club after the end of time (quarter to five)

indicators.note: the end of a word means only its final letter is kept

blocks.note: the last letter of time
north is one of the four quarters, or compass points
V is the Roman numeral five
an iron is a golf club

explanation.surface: Gather round a club at closing time, fifteen minutes before five o'clock.
explanation.walkthrough: After puts IRON at the end; quarter to five puts N before V.
explanation.definitionFit: To environ is to encircle or enclose, a formal verb meaning to surround on all sides.

clue.text: Split up with monster in seedy bar

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

blocks.note: a dive is a disreputable bar
an orc is a monster from fantasy fiction

explanation.surface: Breaking up with a brute you met in a sleazy bar.
explanation.definitionFit: To divorce is to end a marriage legally, so a couple who divorce have split up.

clue.text: Passion's location, diagonally

blocks.note: first meaning: where Christ's Passion, his suffering and death, took place
second meaning: slanting, crosswise

explanation.walkthrough: Passion looks like romance, but it is Christ's suffering at the Crucifixion.
explanation.definitionFit: Christ suffered and died crucified, and a fabric cut slantwise across its weave is cut in that manner too.

clue.text: Solicit crooked sleuth

indicators.note: something crooked is bent out of its true shape, so the letters are twisted round

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A corrupt detective touting for business.
explanation.definitionFit: To hustle is to push for custom, sales or sex aggressively, as a tout or streetwalker solicits.

clue.text: Wooster curtailed development of African townships

indicators.note: curtailing cuts something short, so the last letter is dropped
developing something changes its form, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the name with its tail removed

explanation.surface: P.G. Wodehouse's Bertie Wooster, cut down to size, takes up urban planning in Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: Bertie Wooster is the comic hero of P.G. Wodehouse's novels.
explanation.definitionFit: Soweto, short for South Western Townships, is the group of townships near Johannesburg in South Africa.

clue.text: Force politician to be facile

blocks.note: g is the symbol for gravitational force
Lib is short for a Liberal

explanation.surface: Pressuring an elected representative into giving shallow answers.
explanation.definitionFit: Glib and facile both describe speech that is fluent and easy but superficial and insincere.

clue.text: Parasite swims in front with simple fuel gauge

blocks.note: to dip is to take a quick swim
a tick is a blood-sucking parasite

explanation.surface: A bloodsucker paddling ahead, apparently carrying a basic petrol gauge.
explanation.walkthrough: In front puts the swims piece ahead of the parasite, though the clue mentions the parasite first.
explanation.definitionFit: A dipstick is a graduated rod dipped into a tank to measure the level of oil or fuel, a basic gauge.

clue.text: Keep desiring to be lascivious?

blocks.note: to want is to desire
to keep doing something is to carry on

explanation.surface: Continually craving something, which may be a sign of lust.
explanation.walkthrough: Keep desiring reads as want on, as in to keep going is to go on; the clue's order is reversed in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Wanton means sexually unrestrained or immoral, so it is a synonym of lewd and lustful.

clue.text: Leader of the "Undertones" gets into more strident rock

indicators.note: the leader of a group is the one at the front, so the first letter is kept
getting into something means going inside it

blocks.note: bolder means more brash and forthright
the first letter of the band's name

explanation.surface: The singer of the punk band the Undertones joins a louder kind of rock music.
explanation.walkthrough: The Undertones were a Northern Irish punk band; rock looks like the music genre but is a lump of stone.
explanation.definitionFit: A boulder is a large rock or stone, rounded by weathering or water.

clue.text: Porridge makes good person feel sick

blocks.note: St is the abbreviation for saint, a good person
to retch is to heave as if about to vomit

explanation.surface: Porridge makes a well-behaved diner nauseous.
explanation.walkthrough: Porridge is British slang for time served in prison, as in the sitcom of that name.
explanation.definitionFit: A stretch is a prison sentence in slang, just as porridge means time spent doing a jail term.
